Per-cell depth features on arbitrary regions

Source: R/features.R
region_features.Rd

Sums the 1 Mb window counts (win) of the windows inside each region (window start >= region start and window end <= region end) and returns the feature columns of the long features table: x, e, log2ratio, sd_null (the cell's sd_null of the region's sd_class from the run's features; the nearest available class when missing), z, stratum, n_frag. For regions that are not in the feature table (clone pieces and segments, MEDICC2 pieces). No allelic columns: the callers score those with a clone-specific orientation.

Usage

region_features(
  feat,
  regs,
  cells = NULL,
  sd_floor = caller_defaults()$sd_floor
)

Arguments

feat

scn_features list (or clone_input) with the 1 Mb window depth win

regs

regions table (region, chrom, start, end, class, sd_class)

cells

cells to compute (default all)

sd_floor

floor of sd_null

Value

features long table: cell, region, x, e, class, sd_class, chrom, log2ratio, sd_null, z, n_frag, stratum
